summary: The PR makes the `element_id` argument optional for the `json_script` filter and updates the documentation accordingly. The changes are functional and do not introduce obvious issues.

issues.description: The docstring in `django/template/defaultfilters.py` could be improved for clarity by explicitly mentioning the optional nature of `element_id`.
The docstring in `django/utils/html.py` could be improved for clarity by explicitly mentioning the optional nature of `element_id`.
